title: Route each token to its top k experts
brief: Score every expert, keep the top k, renormalise the weights, mix the chosen experts' outputs, and count stored versus used parameters.
hints: router: logits = x @ W_gate. Subtract each row's max before exponentiating, then divide by the row sum for the full probabilities. np.argsort(-logits, axis=-1)[:, :k] gives the top k, largest first.
To renormalise, pick the kept probabilities with np.take_along_axis(full_probs, topk_indices, axis=-1) and divide each row by its own sum (keepdims=True).
moe_forward: call router, then loop over tokens and over the k slots. Each slot adds gate_weights[t, slot] * (x[t] @ experts[expert]) to output[t]. Experts outside the top k are never touched.
active_parameters: active = k * expert_params + shared_params, and total = n_experts * expert_params + shared_params. Keep shared_params in both.
